name.en-US: The Confutation of Tyndale's Answer, Part II
name.pt-BR: A Refutação da Resposta de Tyndale, Parte II

description.en-US: The second part of More's Confutation (1533), continuing the reply to Tyndale on purgatory, the Eucharist and the Church.
description.pt-BR: A segunda parte da Refutação de More (1533), continuando a resposta a Tyndale sobre o purgatório, a Eucaristia e a Igreja.

sources.edition: The second parte of the co[n]futacion of Tyndals answere (London: 1533), EEBO-TCP A07694.
sources.description: EEBO-TCP hand-keyed transcription, original spelling kept. 3267 illegible places in the source are marked […]. Raw TEI in sources/en-US-originals/.
sources.tierEvidence: St. Thomas More died in 1535; the edition is of 1533 and the TCP transcription is released to the public domain (CC0).
